column2: Every loaded row carries the business date of its load in data_as_of
Buddhist Era years are converted to Gregorian at load; the Workbench stores Gregorian dates
Amounts are stored in THB as numeric with two decimals
Source codes map to Workbench lists through a versioned code map. An unmapped code holds the row in the exception list
National ID and passport numbers are tokenized at load; contact values are masked by role
Source keys are kept on the record; Workbench identifiers are UUIDs
Customer facts come from SCBPDM and the core bank through COLLINS (DL20)
Contact history before day 90 comes from EFS through COLLINS (DL29)
